basics.name: Guanyu Hou
basics.summary: Research in AI safety and security.

work.name: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (PJLab)
highlights: Research on AI4Science safety, including vulnerability detection, safety boundaries, and alignment mechanisms for scientific domains.

work.name: ByteDance
highlights: Multilingual Safety Classifier: Deployed an LLM firewall classifier using supervised fine-tuning and data augmentation, achieving over 97% precision, recall, and F1 globally.
Long-Reasoning Optimization: Developed preprocessing and augmentation pipelines for complex reasoning inputs, improving precision and recall by 1% in internal training infrastructure.
Jailbreak Defense: Used agent-based mining of red-team logs to synthesize targeted hard cases and improve robustness against prompt injection.
